name: Elitz Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Elitz Holdings Co., Ltd. is in the rental real estate brokerage business in Japan, covering rental units and management, a franchise chain, real estate consulting, condominium management and planning, financial planning, operation of monthly apartments, an agency for tenants and insurance, and construction. It also offers corporate housing support, IT development and worker dispatch. Incorporated in 1986, it has its headquarters in Kyoto, Japan.
